function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The analysis has been updated to address the question specifically: why do female patients respond better to the treatment than male patients? This requires comparing response rates within the treatment arm only. The distribution of severity by sex has been computed, showing that males are more likely to have severe disease. The response rate in the treatment arm is higher for males (65.1%) than for females (62.2%), contradicting the claim that females respond better to treatment. Thus, the apparent better overall response in females is due to their over-representation in the control arm, not in the treatment arm. The confounding by severity and arm assignment is now supported by direct evidence from the data."}
function.name: resolve_finding
